acceptanceCriteria: A1: docs/reference/collaboration-language-contract.md(+zh-CN/ja) covers the seven communication nodes with trigger/source, state, must-present info, human-decision need, options' effect/authorization scope, next step/stop boundary, and missing-info/misunderstanding/cancellation handling.

A2: preserves existing Outcome/decision-state/Receipt/block-recovery meanings from glossary.md, protocol spec, and outcome-report.md; introduces no new state/marker/command; any clarification is labeled as such.
A3: explicitly distinguishes authorization reuse (identity-binding match) vs new authorization (Contract/snapshot changed) vs pure technical recovery (retry/successor/supersede).
A4: states ten checkable semantic invariants, each citing current evidence and naming any automated-check gap explicitly.

A5: marks its own verification boundary (doc-structure checks and reviewer reading only; no automated cross-entry-point check, no user study) and lists follow-on Work Items rather than claiming them delivered.
A6: docs/reference/README.md, README.zh-CN.md, README.ja.md each gain exactly one new index entry; no other entry altered.
A7: tests/docs/documentation_acceptance.sh passes for the new and modified files.
goal: A new user or contributor can read one page to understand current state, authorization scope, and stop boundaries at each collaboration moment, and hand off to another Agent/session without losing that understanding.
intent: Deliver a docs-only cross-cutting collaboration-language contract mapping the seven communication moments (task start/scope, authorization, verification, block/recovery, merge confirmation, Outcome, Agent/session hand-off) to existing Runtime facts, per explicit repository-owner delegation to complete the AI Cockpit collaboration-language initiative via the Work Item process.
